status_at_writing: dev1 and dev2 have been scored for experiment A. No Phase 7 metric has been computed on U1, U2, U4 or any dataset bank; the engine has only been regression-tested there against the Phase 4 / 5 scores of the frozen read-outs.

A2_outcome.dev1_selection: the registered rule chose Mh2|a=0|lp|tau=1 (one-sided memory with c = 2 and zero-start propagation): first-appearance miss rate 54.60 vs frozen 56.33, difference -1.73 [-3.02, -0.44]; overall near FPR95 -0.51, far +0.05, x TINS -0.50 (126 candidates, all listed in results/a_dev1_selection.json)
A2_outcome.dev2_confirmation_attempt_1: NOT confirmed: first-appearance miss rate +0.07 [-1.08, +1.22] (criterion: upper bound < 0); overall near FPR95 -0.57 [-0.74, -0.40]
A2_outcome.decision: no further attempt, nothing is locked: on dev1 no candidate reduces the first-appearance miss rate by more than its own interval width, so two more attempts would be a search on dev2. A3 (one-time evaluation of a locked candidate on U1 / U4 and in the intervention) is therefore not executed. The hinge / static-weight read-outs may be shown on U1 / U4 / the intervention only as descriptive rows labelled 'not confirmed on dev2'.

observation_dev1: On the natural dev streams the frozen REPRISE is not below the static p at first appearance (dev1 miss 56.33 vs 62.73, AUROC of k = 1 images 82.18 vs 81.49; dev2 55.67 vs 59.27, 83.05 vs 82.38). The deficit of the paper (82.88 vs 84.20) is the r = 0 point of the intervention design.

A4_new_analysis_delayed_rescoring.origin: designed after the dev1 exploration (post hoc with respect to dev1; dev1 near streams only so far: frozen REPRISE k = 1 miss 56.1 issued, 37.8 after 5 batches, 24.1 at the end of the stream)
A4_new_analysis_delayed_rescoring.definition: The issued score is never changed. '@delay' re-scores an image with the graph and the memory `delay` batches later (frozen components; the image is never its own memory neighbour; ranks against the calibration images under that state). All images (ID and OOD) are re-scored at the same delay; the ID-95% threshold is that of the re-scored ID images. Delays: 1, 2, 5, 10, 20 batches and the end of the stream.
A4_new_analysis_delayed_rescoring.data: U1 and U4 standard streams (45 each), dev2 near streams; frozen REPRISE (p_M x p_LP), p_M only, p_LP only
A4_new_analysis_delayed_rescoring.outcomes: first-appearance (k = 1) miss rate and AUROC per delay; miss rate per appearance bin; overall AUROC / FPR95 per delay; unit split (dev: draw)

confirmatory_on_U1.R1: k = 1 miss rate at delay 5 minus issued: 95% t interval upper bound < 0
confirmatory_on_U1.R2: k = 1 miss rate at the end of the stream minus issued: upper bound < 0
confirmatory_on_U1.R3: overall FPR95 at the end of the stream minus issued: upper bound < 0
